info.title: Clutch API
info.description: The /api/v1 surface of Clutch. Success is `{ data, count? }`, failure `{ error, message, details? }` with `error` from ErrorCode. Generated from the handlers' schemas (apps/web/app/api/v1/_contract); do not edit by hand. Clients must ignore fields they do not know: adding a field is not a breaking change.

get.summary: Service discovery
get.description: Confirms connectivity, the deployed API version and the auth scheme. The authoritative list of operations is this document (docs/api/openapi.json).

post.description: Always 202, whether or not the address has an account. `redirect_to` must be on the deployment's allow-list or the provider ignores it.

post.summary: Trade a refresh token for a new session
post.description: Refresh tokens rotate: store the new pair.
A new account belongs to no club: follow with POST /clubs/{club}/join. With email confirmation on (production), the answer is 202 and no session: the person confirms the address, then signs in.

201.description: Created and signed in (email confirmation off).

202.description: Created; the email address must be confirmed first.

post.summary: Exchange email and password for a session

get.summary: The caller's bookings at one club
get.description: Bookings the caller made (not ones they were invited to: see GET /me/bookings?include=invitations). Newest first, or oldest first from `from`.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The club whose bookings to list.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only bookings on or after this day. With it the list runs oldest first; without it, newest first.

post.description: Creates a `pending` booking that holds the court for 15 minutes. The price is computed server-side. Pay for it and confirm it (POST /bookings/{id}/confirm), or confirm it directly to pay at the club. Two clients racing for one slot cannot both win: the loser gets `409 slot_already_booked`.

get.summary: One booking, with its court, players and dues
get.description: Any booking the caller may see: their own, one they play on, one in a club they belong to, or an open-play session. `404` also means not visible; the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

delete.description: The booker, or club staff who may manage bookings, cancels it (another member of its club gets `403 not_authorized`, anyone else `404`): every payment it holds goes back to whoever made it, or is kept with a stated reason where the club's cancellation window keeps it. A booker cannot cancel a booking that has started, been checked in or marked a no-show, a lesson's court row, or one inside the window when the window keeps the money (`409 cancellation_window_passed`). The slot is released and anyone on the waiting list is told.

post.description: The booker, or club staff who may manage bookings, cancels it (another member of its club gets `403 not_authorized`, anyone else `404`): every payment it holds goes back to whoever made it, or is kept with a stated reason where the club's cancellation window keeps it. A booker cannot cancel a booking that has started, been checked in or marked a no-show, a lesson's court row, or one inside the window when the window keeps the money (`409 cancellation_window_passed`). The slot is released and anyone on the waiting list is told.

Moves the caller's `pending` booking to `confirmed` and clears its hold. With `payment_intent_id`, the intent must have succeeded for exactly this booking and this caller (`402 payment_not_verified` otherwise, and the booking stays pending); it is recorded as the payment only if it covers the price at this moment. Without it the booking is to be paid at the club. Confirming again after the payment already confirmed it returns the booking.

post.summary: Invite a group's roster onto the caller's booking
post.description: The group's current active club members are invited in one transaction (a snapshot), bounded by the seats left. The booking must be the caller's, confirmed and not ended, and the caller in the group. Existing shares never change; new invitees split only what nobody has paid or promised, or owe nothing when the booker already paid.

post.summary: Invite club members onto a booking
post.description: The booker, or club staff who may manage bookings, invites members (others are skipped), bounded by the booking's seats. A player who already accepted or paid is never changed; a declined one is invited again. Shares come out of what the booking still owes and nobody has promised; without `shares` it is split evenly.

200.description: Done. Read the booking for who is on it.

post.summary: Move the caller's booking to another slot
post.description: Only the booker moves their own booking; anyone else's answers `404`. The cancel rule applies, and only a plain court booking moves (not a lesson's court, not one date of a standing reservation). A booking with anything collected or committed toward it, or priced by staff, keeps its price and moves only to a slot whose court time costs no more (`409 reschedule_costs_more`); anything else is repriced at the new slot.

post.summary: Cancel the caller's registration for a class session
post.description: Within the club's cancellation window only. A confirmed registration paid with a pass gives the pass back. Cancelling one that is already cancelled succeeds.

Needs a confirmed enrollment in the session's program. A session that is not free spends one of the enrollment's session passes (`no_session_passes` when none is left). A session that filled up first answers with status `waitlisted`, not an error.

post.summary: Join a full class session's waitlist
post.description: Only for a full session: one with places left answers `session_not_full`, so register instead.

201.description: The waitlisted registration and its position.

get.summary: The club directory
get.description: Active clubs by name, the same for every caller.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the club's name, any case.

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Only clubs with a court of it.

post.summary: Create a club with its courts, hours, rules and pricing
post.description: One database transaction: a failure leaves nothing behind. The caller needs `clubs:create` (an API key) or a platform role that creates clubs (an access token), and becomes the owner unless `owner_user_id` says otherwise. Send an `Idempotency-Key`: a retry then replays the first answer instead of failing with `slug_already_exists`.

201.description: The new club, as `GET /clubs/{club}` answers it.

get.summary: One club, with its courts, hours, pricing and booking rules

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

get.summary: The slot grid for one day, priced for the caller
get.description: Every active court with every slot of the day and its status, accounting for bookings, recurring bookings, academy sessions, closures and opening hours. Prices are for the caller: send the member's token to get member prices; without one, public prices. A token the auth server rejects is refused rather than priced as a visitor. There is no realtime feed: re-fetch every 15 to 30 seconds for a live grid.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day, in the club's timezone.

200.description: One entry per court, in display order.

get.summary: The caller's class sessions on a day
get.description: Scheduled sessions on `date` of the programs the caller is confirmed in, grouped by program, in start order. Empty for a caller who is not an evaluated student of the club, or who is in no program with a session that day.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

200.description: The programs with sessions that day.

get.summary: The club's bookable courts, in display order

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

post.summary: Join a club as a player
post.description: Idempotent. `joined` is true when this call created the membership; otherwise the caller already had one and `status` says what it is. Joining again does not lift a suspension. Read GET /me afterwards for the full membership: never infer membership from this call alone.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

200.description: Where the caller now stands at the club.

get.summary: The club's membership plans and the caller's own

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

get.summary: Programs the caller may enroll in
get.description: Published and running programs, in term order, filtered to what the caller may see: programs are for evaluated students (staff and coaches see all), a levelled program only for members on that level, a private one only through an enrollment. Empty for a member who has not been evaluated yet.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

post.description: Only the invitee may answer. `invitation_not_found` also means the invitation is someone else's.

get.summary: One group with its roster
get.description: Members only. A non-member gets `403 not_authorized` whether or not the group exists.

patch.description: Owner only. Any of the fields; the others are left as they are.

delete.description: Owner only. Removes the roster, invitations and links; the group's chat lives on as a plain group conversation.

get.summary: Bookings organised with the group
get.description: Members only. `upcoming` is a live booking that has not ended on the club's clock, soonest first; `past` is everything else (cancelled and completed included), latest first. At most 50.

post.summary: Get or create the group's chat
post.description: Members only. Answers 201 whether the chat was created now or already existed. Its participants follow the roster: a member who joins later is added, one who leaves or is removed loses the chat.
Owner only. Replaces the previous cover.

201.description: The cover's public URL (also the group's new `cover_image_url`).

post.description: Any member may invite. People who are not active members of the club, are already on the roster or already invited are skipped.

Any member may mint one. The raw `token` is in this response and nowhere else: only its hash is stored, so it cannot be read back later (a retry with the same Idempotency-Key replays this response). A link dies with its creator's membership.

201.description: The link, with its token shown this once.

post.description: An owner with other members must transfer ownership first. The last member leaving deletes the group.

get.summary: A group's roster
get.description: Members only. The same roster `GET /groups/{id}` carries.

patch.description: The only role change there is: ownership moves to that member and the caller becomes a member. The caller must be the current owner.

delete.description: Owner only. Removal is durable: the invite links the member created and the pending invitations they sent or held are revoked with them, and they lose the group chat.

post.summary: See the group behind an invite link
post.description: Does not use up the link. The group's `my_role` is null unless the caller is already a member. `410 invite_link_invalid` for any link that is not live.

200.description: The group, and whether the caller is on its roster.

post.summary: Join a group with an invite link
post.description: Uses one of the link's joins. `410 invite_link_invalid` when the link is unknown, expired, revoked, used up, or its creator has left.

get.summary: The caller's profile and every club membership
get.description: The first call after sign-in: the token carries no roles and no club. `memberships` lists every membership whatever its standing (`status`), so an empty list means the account has joined no club, and a suspended membership is visible as one. If either part cannot be read the request fails; it never answers with a partial list.

post.description: multipart/form-data with one `file` field: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, at most 5 MB. The profile's avatar_url is set to the returned URL.

get.summary: The caller's bookings, or their pending invitations
get.description: Without `include`, the same list as GET /bookings, each item marked `kind: booking`. With `include=invitations`, the caller's pending invitations to other people's live bookings instead, each marked `kind: invitation`: every one of them (`limit` and `offset` do not apply), `count` being how many. Branch on `kind`.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The club whose bookings to list.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only bookings on or after this day. With it the list runs oldest first; without it, newest first.

200.description: A page of bookings, or every pending invitation.

get.summary: The caller's credit balance at a club
get.description: A booking paid with credits costs one credit whatever its price, so do not present credits as money. The transaction log is GET /me/credits/history (`include=history` here is refused with invalid_field).

200.description: The balance; zero when the club never granted any.

get.summary: The caller's credit transactions at a club, newest first
The caller's program enrollments at a club
get.description: Newest first. A cancelled enrollment stays listed for two minutes after it was cancelled, then drops off.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The club the list is about.

get.summary: The caller's pending group invitations
get.description: Newest first. Invitations from a club where the caller is not an active member are left out: they cannot be accepted.

get.summary: The caller's groups
get.description: Newest first, across every club where the caller is an active member. Filter by `club_id` for one club.

post.description: The caller becomes its owner. The listed people are invited in the same transaction; anyone who is not an active member of the club is skipped.

get.summary: The home screen in one call
get.description: The caller's profile, their next pending or confirmed bookings at the club (up to 10, from today, oldest first) and the club's latest announcements (up to 5). Each part must load or the request fails. For the authoritative booking list use GET /me/bookings.

get.summary: Sign-in providers linked to the account
The caller's membership at a club, and the plan behind it
get.description: `membership` is null when the caller is not a member of the club at all; `subscription` is null when the membership has no tier. A failed read fails the request: null always means none.

get.summary: The in-app inbox, newest first

post.summary: Mark one notification, or all of them, read
post.description: Body `{ "id": "<uuid>" }` for one, or `{ "all": true }`.

200.description: The notification, now read; null when `all` marked the whole inbox.

get.summary: What the caller was charged at a club, newest first
get.description: A refund moves the original row's refunded_amount_cents and is also listed as its own `refund` row with a negative amount.

get.summary: The caller's notification preferences

put.description: A full replace: every category with all three channels. `smsPhone` is optional; null or absent clears it. Unknown keys are dropped.

200.description: The preferences as stored (smsPhone normalised to E.164).

get.summary: The caller's profile

patch.summary: Change the display name and/or username
patch.description: Both fields are written in one update: a bad value or a taken username changes nothing.

get.summary: The club's waivers and the caller's signatures
get.description: Every active waiver of the club, in the club's order. A booking or an enrollment is refused until the required ones are signed.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The club the list is about.

get.summary: One program
get.description: Under the same visibility rules as the list; a program the caller may not see is `program_not_found`. Sessions are read per day with `GET /clubs/{club}/classes`.

post.description: A full program yields an enrollment with status `waitlisted` rather than an error, so read `status`. A priced program, or one the club confirms by hand, yields `pending`. The club's required waivers must be signed first (`waiver_required`, with the club in `details.club_id`).

get.summary: The caller's open waiting-list entries at a club
get.description: Unfulfilled entries, by date and start time.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The club the list is about.

post.description: When a matching slot frees, everyone waiting is notified; the slot is not assigned. Book on the notification. Name a `court_id`, or a `court_type` for any court of that type.
Records the signature with a snapshot of the waiver text as it read at signing, so later edits cannot rewrite it. Only an active waiver of one of the caller's clubs can be signed.

player_ids.description: The members to invite. The caller is ignored.

shares.description: Cents each named player owes, by user id.

Announcement.description: A club announcement, pinned ones first.

AuthSession.description: A session. The token carries no roles and no club: read them from GET /me.

access_token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Valid for an hour.

refresh_token.description: Single use: POST /auth/refresh returns a new one.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

expires_at.description: Unix time the access token expires at.

user.description: Enough to key a cache. Everything else is GET /me.

price_cents.description: What this caller pays for this one slot (not per hour), in the minor unit of `currency`: the member price for a member of the club, the public price otherwise (always for a request without a token). 0 when the slot has no price.

member_price_cents.description: The member price for this slot, minor unit; null when members pay the public price.

BillingInterval.description: How often a membership plan bills.

Booking.description: One of the caller's own bookings, with its court's name and what they owe on it.

user_id.description: The booker. Null for a walk-in booked at the desk.

booking_type.description: One of `court` (a court booking) or `lesson` (the court a lesson holds; cancel the lesson, not this).

end_time.description: `00:00:00` means midnight at the end of `date`.

day_of_week.description: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday, each at most once.

default_price_cents.description: Price per hour on every court during opening hours, minor unit of `currency`; 0 creates no pricing rules.

owner_user_id.description: Make this account the owner instead of the caller. Needs a provisioning grant that allows it.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the link expires, 1-365. Omitted: it never expires.

max_uses.description: Joins the link allows. Omitted: unlimited.

rotate.description: Owner only: revoke every live link of the group first.

token.description: The secret to share (in a join URL). Shown once; store it if you need it again.

club_id.description: A club where the caller is an active member.

description.description: Up to 500 characters; empty or null means none.

amount.description: Credits; negative when spent or expired.

transaction_type.description: purchase, usage, refund, adjustment or expiry.

reference_id.description: What it was for (a booking, a package), when anything.

player_id.description: Who to enroll. Defaults to the caller; set it to enroll a family member.

enrolled_by.description: Recorded as who made the enrollment. Defaults to the caller.

message.description: Human-readable, safe to show or log, never load-bearing.

details.description: Structured values for codes that carry one.

request_id.description: On internal_error: the X-Request-Id to quote.

ErrorCode.description: Every value `error` can take. Branch on this, never on `message`.

version.description: API_VERSION, also on every response as X-Api-Version.

Group.description: A group with its roster and the caller's permissions.

club_id.description: The club the group belongs to. A group never spans clubs.

description.description: Up to 500 characters; null when none.

cover_image_url.description: Public URL of the cover image; null when none.

member_count.description: Members on the roster, the owner included.

my_role.description: The caller's role. Null only when the caller is not a member (an invite-link preview).

members.description: The roster: the owner first, then by joined_at.

GroupActivityItem.description: A booking the group's roster was invited onto.

end_time.description: 00:00 means midnight at the end of `date`.

court_type.description: The court's sport: tennis, padel, pickleball, badminton, squash or other.

organizer_id.description: The booker; null when their account is gone.

participant_count.description: Invited players who have not declined. The organizer is not counted.

i_am_participant.description: The caller is the organizer or an invited player who has not declined.

GroupInvitation.description: An invitation addressed to the caller, waiting for an answer.

GroupMember.description: One person on a group's roster: what one member may see of another (no contact details).

full_name.description: Null when the person has no profile.

GroupPermissions.description: What the caller may do with the group, for showing or hiding controls. The server checks every action again; these flags only save a client from offering what will be refused.

can_edit.description: May rename, describe and set or clear the cover. Owner only.

can_delete.description: May delete the group. Owner only.

can_manage_members.description: May remove members and transfer ownership. Owner only.

can_invite.description: May invite people and mint invite links. Every member.

can_leave.description: May leave now. False for an owner with other members: transfer first.

GroupRole.description: A member's role in a group. A group has exactly one owner.

GroupSummary.description: A group as listed: no roster.

club_id.description: The club the group belongs to. A group never spans clubs.

description.description: Up to 500 characters; null when none.

cover_image_url.description: Public URL of the cover image; null when none.

member_count.description: Members on the roster, the owner included.

my_role.description: The caller's role. Null only when the caller is not a member (an invite-link preview).

provider.description: email, google, apple, ... as the identity provider names it.

InboxNotification.description: One entry in the in-app inbox.

type.description: booking_confirmed, booking_cancelled, booking_invitation, group_invitation, session_booked, ... New types are added over time; treat an unknown one as generic.

invited.description: The user ids added; empty when everyone was already on the booking.
The ids that got an invitation; the rest were skipped.

token.description: The token from an invite link.

count.description: Rows the query matched, for paging.

tiers.description: Plans on offer, in display order.

subscription.description: The caller's plan at this club; null when they have none.

count.description: Rows the query matched, for paging.
Rows the query matched, for paging.
Rows the query matched, for paging.
Rows the query matched, for paging.
Rows the query matched, for paging.

MembershipRole.description: What the person is at the club. Only an admin's invitation grants more than player.

MembershipStatus.description: The person's standing at the club. Only `active` may book, enrol or join groups there.

MembershipSubscription.description: The caller's plan at a club.

price_cents.description: The plan's price per `interval`, in the minor unit of `currency`.

status.description: The membership's standing at the club.

current_period_end.description: When the paid period ends (the next renewal); null when not billed on a schedule.

MembershipTier.description: A membership plan a club offers.

price_cents.description: Price per billing `interval`, in the minor unit of `currency`.

advance_booking_days.description: How many days ahead a member on this plan may book.

MyBooking.description: A Booking in GET /me/bookings, marked `kind: booking`.

user_id.description: The booker. Null for a walk-in booked at the desk.

status.description: `pending` holds the court until `hold_expires_at` and becomes `confirmed`; `cancelled`, `completed` and `no_show` are final.

booking_type.description: One of `court` (a court booking) or `lesson` (the court a lesson holds; cancel the lesson, not this).

date.description: The day, in the club's timezone.

end_time.description: `00:00:00` means midnight at the end of `date`.

price_cents.description: What the booking costs, after any discount, in cents of `currency`.

original_price_cents.description: The list price before the discount, in cents. Null on older bookings.

discount_amount_cents.description: What a discount code took off, in cents.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the club's currency, e.g. `EUR`.

price_source.description: One of `list` (the club's price list) or `staff` (club staff set the price; it no longer follows the list).

payment_status.description: One of `none`, `pending`, `partial`, `paid`, `refunded`. The booking's, not one player's: what a person owes is `my_due_cents` or `dues`.

paid_cents.description: What has been collected toward the booking, from everyone, in cents.

paid_at.description: When it was paid in full; null until then.

hold_expires_at.description: A pending booking's hold: the slot is released at this instant unless confirmed. Null once confirmed.

recurring_booking_id.description: Set when this is one date of a standing weekly reservation; such a date can be cancelled but not moved.

qr_code.description: The check-in code to show at the club. GET /bookings/{id} gives it only to the booker (null for anyone else).

notes.description: GET /bookings/{id} gives it only to the booker (null for anyone else).

no_show_recorded_at.description: Set when the club marked the booking a no-show.

is_rainout.description: Cancelled by the club for weather.

is_open_play.description: An open-play session other members can join.

open_play_visibility.description: One of `public` (any member can find it) or `private` (invitees, with a password).

court_name.description: Null when the court is not visible to the caller.

share_path.description: The path of the booking's share link on the web app (`/join/<token>`), on a live (pending or confirmed) booking. Null otherwise, or when the link could not be minted.

my_due_cents.description: What the caller (the booker) still owes on it, in cents: the part the others' shares leave them, less what they paid. On a live booking only; null otherwise.

my_paid_cents.description: What the caller has paid toward it, net of anything given back, in cents. On a live booking only; null otherwise.

MyProgramEnrollment.description: One of the caller's enrollments, with its program's name.

player_id.description: Who is enrolled: the caller, or a family member.

status.description: `pending` waits for payment or for the club's confirmation; `waitlisted` waits for a place.

session_passes.description: Sessions the player may still book with passes (per-session programs).

NotificationPreferences.description: Which channels each kind of notification may use. The senders honour it.

smsPhone.description: E.164. Absent when none is stored.

OperatingHours.description: Opening hours for one day of the week, in the club's timezone. A day with no entry is closed.

is_closed.description: Closed all day; ignore the two times.

payment_type.description: booking, membership, package, tournament, academy, refund, pos, club_account or custom.

payment_method.description: stripe, credits, venue_cash, venue_card, card_on_file, ach_bank_transfer, qr_code, tap_to_pay or terminal.

status.description: succeeded, pending, processing, failed or refunded.

token.description: The token from an invite link.

PricingRule.description: A price for court time in a window of a day. For what a given caller pays per slot, use the availability grid.

court_id.description: The court it prices; null prices every court without a rule of its own.

price_cents.description: Price per hour of court time, in the minor unit of `currency`.

member_price_cents.description: Per hour for members, minor unit; null when members pay `price_cents`.

Profile.description: The caller's own profile. Wider than what other members can see.

email.description: The sign-in address. Empty when the account has none.

Program.description: An academy program as a member sees it.

status.description: A member only ever sees `published` and `in_progress`.

duration_minutes.description: Length of one session, in minutes.

skill_level_id.description: The level the program is for. Null: open to every evaluated member.

skill_level_name.description: That level's name, matched against the member's own level.

prerequisite_program_id.description: A program the player must have completed first. Null: none.

member_price_cents.description: Price for a member with a membership tier. Null: no member price.

pricing_model.description: One of `free`, `program_total`, `per_session` (paid per session with passes) or `deposit`.

schedule_pattern.description: The weekly pattern, club-local. Empty when none is set.

registration_confirmation_mode.description: `instant`, or `staff`: an enrollment stays `pending` until the club confirms it.

is_private.description: Private programs are visible only to players enrolled in them.

is_enrolled.description: The caller has a pending, confirmed or waitlisted enrollment.

ProgramEnrollment.description: A player's enrollment in a program.

player_id.description: Who is enrolled: the caller, or a family member.

status.description: `pending` waits for payment or for the club's confirmation; `waitlisted` waits for a place.

session_passes.description: Sessions the player may still book with passes (per-session programs).

new_court_id.description: Another court of the same club; default the booking's own.

SessionRegistration.description: The caller's place in a class session.

status.description: `waitlisted` when the session filled up first.

SignUpPending.description: Sign-up accepted; nothing to sign in with until the address is confirmed.

user.description: The account, when the provider names it. Null when it does not (an address that already had an account is not revealed).

password.description: At least 8 characters; shorter is password_too_short.

signer_name.description: The signing adult's name, when signing for a minor.

SlotStatus.description: `available`: can be booked. `booked`: taken by a booking, a recurring booking or an academy session. `maintenance`: not offered for booking (for example, the club set no price for it). `past`: already started.

TierRef.description: A membership tier, by id and name. GET /clubs/{club}/membership-tiers has the rest.

UpdateGroupRequest.description: At least one of the three.

description.description: Up to 500 characters; null or empty clears it.

UpdateMyProfileRequest.description: At least one of the two.

file.description: The image: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, at most 5 MB.

data.description: Public URL, already on the profile.

WaitingListEntry.description: A wish for a court slot that is booked now: the caller is told when it frees.

WaiverSignature.description: A signature the caller made. The text it agreed to is kept with it.

WaiverStatus.description: One of the club's active waivers, and whether the caller has signed it.

content.description: The text to show before signing.

is_required.description: Booking or enrolling is refused until it is signed.

frequency.description: `every_time` waivers expire and must be signed again for each visit, whatever `signed` says.

signed.description: The caller has signed it at least once.

signed_at.description: The caller's latest signature. Null when never signed.

signer_name.description: The name on that signature, when one was given.

bearer.description: A Supabase access token for a person, or an API key (clutch_sk_...).
